# Getting Started with the CLI {#intro}

This tool turns prose into *clean* segments. It handles **bold**, `inline code`, and [links](https://example.com/docs) without fuss. See e.g. the docs, Dr. Smith said... it works!

::: note
Fenced divs from pandoc are ignored.
:::

## Install

Run `go install` to build it. The tool costs $5 and was released in 1989, with 50% fewer bugs.
